analysis.title: The 720: China Industrial Tech, DBS, Nintendo, Sony, Toyota Motor, LG Chem, Weichai Power, DISCO, CICC, Rohm
key_insights: China Industrial Tech 2027 outlook favors the AI robotics supply chain and Data Center Electricals. Overseas data center progress is solid, but mass adoption of 800VDC is delayed to 2028.

GS forecasts China grid investment to grow 6% y/y in 2027, with more emphasis on UHV. It cuts 2026-2030 sector EPS estimates by 5-10% on average, mainly in battery and energy storage names, on raw-material inflation and margin pressure.

GS upgrades Jianghai (002484.SZ) to Buy with a 12m TP of Rmb43.9 on a rising AI product mix and earnings visibility. Preferred China industrial tech names: Inovance, Shuanghuan, Sanhua, Kstar, Envicool, Hongfa, Sieyuan, Huaming, Nari Tech.

Sieyuan and Huaming stay Buy but 12m TPs fall to Rmb145 and Rmb22.3 on regulatory overhang from US Executive Order 14421 and easing transformer supply shortages. Sieyuan 2027-30E EPS is cut 9-14% as global capacity additions raise competition and trim overseas gross margins. North American orders from cloud providers remain resilient.

DBS 3Q26 net profit was S$2,813mn, 3% below GS estimates. Net interest income was strong, but markets trading was weak. NPL ratio improved to 0.9% and record net new money was S$15bn. 2027 guidance of mid-single-digit income growth is below GS's 9.5%. TP stays S$83, Buy.

Nintendo 2Q operating profit of ¥73.9bn missed on weak Switch 2 hardware sell-in despite a software beat. GS cuts FY27E operating profit by 6% to ¥401.8bn and FY28E-FY31E by 2-7%. TP stays ¥9,800, Buy.

Sony 2Q operating profit was ¥622.3bn, a beat, on record box office for Spider-Man: Brand New Day and PlayStation engagement. Management raised FY3/27 operating profit guidance to ¥1,870bn. GS raises FY3/27-FY3/31 estimates 6-9% on a ¥160/USD assumption and lifts TP to ¥4,800, Buy.

Taiyo Yuden 2Q operating profit was ¥13.4bn vs GS ¥12.0bn estimate. Full-year guidance rose from ¥45.0bn to ¥54.0bn on pricing. AI server demand for inductors is arriving ahead of schedule and MLCC utilization is expected at or above 95% in 2H. TP rises to ¥22,200 from ¥21,300, Buy.

Rohm 2Q operating profit of ¥7.9bn missed GS's ¥18.2bn on one-off costs. Full-year guidance was raised to ¥50.0bn from ¥30.0bn on AI server strength and SiC recovery. GS cuts FY3/27-FY3/29 operating profit by 24%/10%/7% and TP to ¥6,900 from ¥7,200, Buy.

NYPCB 3Q26 gross margin rose 4.6ppt sequentially, slightly below GS estimates due to the Kunshan ramp. GS expects gross and operating margins of 35.5% and 33.0% in 4Q26 and high-end ABF revenue exposure above 40% by 2027E. TP NT$2,700, Buy.

Toyota Jul-Sep operating profit was ¥1.13tn, above consensus. FY3/27 operating profit guidance was raised to ¥3.9tn and the buyback limit to ¥1.3tn. Medium-term capital allocation targets imply total shareholder returns could approach 100% by FY3/31. GS adds a robotics business to valuation and raises TP to ¥4,300, Buy.

LG Chem TP falls to W410,000 and 2026/2027/2028 EBITDA estimates are cut 8%/3%/1% on in-line 3Q26, weaker petrochemical margins and lower subsidiary forecasts. Cathode shipments are expected to roughly double in 2027. Shares trade at a near-record 77% discount to NAV. Buy.

Mahindra & Mahindra FY27E-FY29E EPS rises 3.3-4.4% and TP to Rs3,850 from Rs3,700 after in-line 2Q. Management expects lower input costs and cut the FY27 tractor volume outlook from 5% growth to flat, implying about a 10% decline in 2H. Buy.
Sansera Engineering 2Q revenue, EBITDA and adjusted PAT grew 32%, 48% and 51% y/y. TP stays Rs5,260, Buy.
Titan 2QFY27 margins beat in most segments. TP rises to Rs5,800 from Rs5,600 and FY27E EPS rises about 10% on one-off Damas gains. Domestic jewellery EBIT grew 23% y/y and Caratlane fell 15%. Buy.
LG Electronics India 2QFY27 revenue grew 19.5% y/y and EBITDA beat GS by 24%. It is entering vehicle solutions with a Sri City plant. TP stays Rs1,900, Buy.
Weichai Power targets Rmb70bn of AI data center power revenue by 2030E. GS expects the segment to exceed 50% of earnings by 2028E. TPs are HK$55 (H) and Rmb48 (A), Buy on Conviction List.
DISCO management sees no deceleration in generative AI equipment demand, strong HBM volumes and co-packaged optics as a new driver. TP stays ¥105,000, Buy.

CICC management expects near-term EPS and ROE dilution from integration, a medium-to-long-term ROE target of about 15%, cost savings of Rmb0.5-1.0bn a year, and a payout ratio of 30-31%. TPs are HK$36.09 (H) and Rmb54.18 (A).

China Consumer Durables 3Q26 revenue and profit fell a weighted average 5% and 11% y/y. Midea, Anker and Roborock are preferred. GS upgrades XGimi to Neutral and cuts estimates and TPs for Oppein and Apptronics.
Sino Biopharm signed a Boehringer Ingelheim collaboration on six preclinical oncology programs with US$358mn upfront and near-term payments and up to US$7bn total deal value. TP stays HK$9.07.

Hyperscaler global debt issuance reached $296bn year to date, above GS's $250bn full-year 2026 forecast and 36% of capex. GS expects 35% of 2027 hyperscaler capex (about $440bn) to be debt-financed plus $300bn of project finance. Total AI-related debt issuance is tracking at $687bn. GS sees near-term risk tilted toward spread widening.

IREN F1Q27 EBITDA of $66mn beat GS's $28mn estimate, with AI Cloud Services revenue of $200mn. The CY2026 ARR target slipped to early 2027. A five-year deal at about $22mn/MW had 90% of GPU capex prepaid. Rating Neutral, TP $50.
